dimension_conflicts.printed: rho*H with H described in J/mol
dimension_conflicts.implementation: accept only an explicit W/m^3 field or corrected BV callback

algorithm_assumptions.choice: Tait cold energy plus constant cv

component-wise WENO5-JS reconstruction of primitive rho,u,v,T,lambda values derived from conservative cell averages; each left/right trace uses an independent affine normalization over its exact five-cell stencil
algorithm_assumptions.warning: the derived primitive values are not exact primitive-variable cell averages and this is not characteristic reconstruction

algorithm_assumptions.choice: source evaluated at every SSPRK stage
local first-order HLL only on an invalid reconstructed face
algorithm_assumptions.diagnostic: count, fraction and maximum absolute raw conservative-component correction
algorithm_assumptions.warning: the correction components carry mixed physical units and are not a dimensionless error norm

algorithm_assumptions.diagnostic: zero-contour area drift and sign-change count

algorithm_assumptions.choice: row-wise with a three-cell WENO halo
passive level-set with a single EOS
algorithm_assumptions.warning: phi does not choose phase, EOS, properties, source masks or interface jumps; this is not a ghost-fluid or overlapping-grid reproduction

implemented_numerical_safety_guards.implementation: N=1 analytic logarithmic limit and expm1((N-1)*log(rho/rho0))/(N-1) for nearby N
implemented_numerical_safety_guards.purpose: avoid cancellation in cold specific energy

implemented_numerical_safety_guards.implementation: reconstruct primitive fields and rebuild conservative face states before HLL
implemented_numerical_safety_guards.purpose: avoid component-wise conservative-energy weights changing under an arbitrary Tait reference-energy offset

implemented_numerical_safety_guards.implementation: scale nonlinear-weight denominators by their pointwise minimum instead of directly forming inverse squares
implemented_numerical_safety_guards.purpose: avoid overflow for very small positive epsilon

implemented_numerical_safety_guards.implementation: limit explicit flow and solid reaction steps by both progress headroom and temperature-floor headroom for cooling signed heat
implemented_numerical_safety_guards.purpose: prevent a valid pre-stage state from stepping below the configured temperature reject floor

implemented_numerical_safety_guards.implementation: reject any stage where joule_heat plus electrochemical_heat is negative
implemented_numerical_safety_guards.purpose: keep the current provider contract limited to electrical heating rather than unbounded cooling

implemented_numerical_safety_guards.implementation: versioned history and grid-working-set planning guards plus runtime measured stage-metadata accounting
implemented_numerical_safety_guards.purpose: reject configured resource excess before major allocation or accepted-history commit
implemented_numerical_safety_guards.warning: planning estimates and Python-object measurements do not guarantee OS RSS, allocator fragmentation, third-party workspaces or instantaneous peak memory

current_structural_limitations: material_level_set is transported but does not select phase, EOS, properties, source masks or interface jump conditions
Eq. (1) Euler and Eq. (2) condensed states advance independently over the full grid with no heat, mass or momentum exchange
electrical heat is applied to Eq. (1) only and is not duplicated in Eq. (2)
Species-front output is a fixed positive-x ray displacement diagnostic, not true local-normal speed; multiple-intersection rays are excluded
the row-partition and halo API is not integrated into the ReactiveSolver time loop and actual MPI ranks are untested
no reactive CUDA, sm_80, A100 or batch backend is implemented
finite conservation residuals are diagnostic-only because no calibrated absolute and scale-aware tolerances exist; non-finite residuals fail closed
geometry_ranking_eligible is always false until a concrete corrected BC adapter enforces potential convergence, current balance and BV residuals
forbidden_hidden_substitutions: no default material constants in solver constructors
no constant extended electrical source when its callback is absent
no reaction-progress contour used as material_level_set
no legacy area/front-length metric labelled as paper regression velocity
no fixed positive-x ray displacement labelled as true local-normal regression velocity
no finite conservation residual labelled passed without calibrated absolute and scale-aware tolerances
no electrode-geometry ranking eligibility from self-attested callback metadata
no CUDA, A100, MPI, paper reproduction or experimental pass claim without execution
